items.text: Develop and maintain Linux BSP for ARM-based embedded platforms.
Perform BSP porting, board bring-up, and system integration.
Develop and customize embedded Linux distributions.
Work closely with product managers and hardware teams on platform development and integration.

Experience with embedded SoC platforms (e.g., NVIDIA, Qualcomm, NXP) is a plus.
Firmware development experience is a plus.

description.text:
Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Linux BSP for ARM-based embedded platforms.
• Perform BSP porting, board bring-up, and system integration.
• Develop and customize embedded Linux distributions.
• Work closely with product managers and hardware teams on platform development and integration.
Qualifications
• Experience in Embedded Linux development.
• Familiar with Linux kernel and device driver development.
• Proficient in C/C++ programming.
• Experience with embedded SoC platforms (e.g., NVIDIA, Qualcomm, NXP) is a plus.
• Firmware development experience is a plus.
